title: Memory V2 Prod-Readiness Validation + 1000-Entry Stress
description:
Memory V2 Prod-Readiness Validation + 1000-Entry Stress
- Model: opus
- Effort: normal
- Skills: testing-expert
- Files: tests/integration/memory-v2-prod-readiness.test.ts (yeni), tests/integration/memory-v2-stress.test.ts (yeni)
- Scope: tests/integration/

### Description
Memory V2 DB-first mimarinin beta öncesi kanıtlanmış prod-ready olması.

**Test 1 (prod-readiness E2E):**
- DB initialize (`getMemoryStore()`)
- 7 entry tipi insert (adr, memory, sprint, debt, pattern, retro, identity)
- Tag many-to-many association
- Relations (references, supersedes)
- FTS5 dual-layer query (TR text "kararlı düzgün" + EN "stable safe" + DE "Sicherheit")
- Decay trigger (sprint 100, decay_after_sprints 3 → eski entry'ler "decayed")
- Export to .md + parse back to DB → roundtrip integrity
- MCP `deckent_memory_query` smoke
- CLI `deckent recall "test"` ve `deckent remember "note"` smoke

**Test 2 (1000-entry stress):**
- 1000 random entry insert (mixed tipler)
- 100 random tag insert
- 200 random relation insert
- FTS5 search 50 query (random text) → tümü < 100ms response
- Concurrent read 20 thread (Promise.all 20x query) → no error
- DB file boyutu rapor (< 5MB hedef)
- Export tüm DB → .md (< 500ms hedef)
- Decay 500 entry → ms ölçüm

### Test (yukarıdaki 2 dosya, toplam 15+ test)
1-7: Prod-readiness E2E (yukarıdaki 7 madde her biri 1 test)
8-15: Stress test (insert/query/concurrent/decay/export performans + integrity)

**Kanıt:** `npx vitest run tests/integration/memory-v2-prod-readiness.test.ts` 7+/7+ PASS, `npx vitest run tests/integration/memory-v2-stress.test.ts` 8+/8+ PASS, performans hedefleri (< 100ms query, < 500ms export) tutturuldu.
